rows.en: ＊Tomoe＊＠１７５＿０１６Um... I'm sorry to bother you￥when you're tired.＝＠１７５＿０１７Could I... talk to you for￥a little bit?
＊Tomoe＊＠１７５＿０１８Thank goodness... I'm sorry for￥asking so suddenly.
＊Tomoe＊＠１７５＿０２０Um, could we go to the￥Common Floor?＝＠１７５＿０２１It should be quiet￥at this hour...
＊Tomoe＊＠１７６＿００１The stars are beautiful...￥A starry sky is so lovely...

＊Tomoe＊＠１７６＿００２This is the first time I've ever￥seen the stars this close.＝＠１７６＿００３Sophia, where we lived, was an￥inward-facing sphere colony,￥right?＝＠１７６＿００４So unless you went out to the￥hull or near the port, you￥couldn't see the stars...
＊Tomoe＊＠１７６＿００５And besides... I didn't really￥leave the house much...
＊Tomoe＊＠１７６＿００６Yes. To think I'd never seen￥anything this beautiful...＝＠１７６＿００７I really missed out on￥so much, didn't I?
＊Tomoe＊＠１７６＿０１０It still doesn't feel real to me￥that I'm here as a candidate...
＊Tomoe＊＠１７６＿０１１Me, someone who'd never even￥seen the stars up close...＝＠１７６＿０１２Far from home and from Sophia,￥looking at the stars out here...￥It feels so strange.
＊Tomoe＊＠１７６＿０１３The candidates gathered here￥are all such amazing people,￥aren't they?＝＠１７６＿０１４They all have what it takes￥to be chosen...
＊Tomoe＊＠１７６＿０１５And me...＝＠１７６＿０１６Lately, all I do is fail...
＊Tomoe＊＠１７６＿０１７You're... right.＝＠１７６＿０１８Maybe it goes wrong because I￥keep thinking it'll go wrong?
＊Tomoe＊＠１７６＿０１９I have to be stronger...＝＠１７６＿０２０I still can't break this habit￥of touching my charm, either...
＊Tomoe＊＠１７６＿０２２I'm hopeless...￥I have to be stronger...＝＠１７６＿０２３I still can't stop myself from￥reaching for my charm...

＊Tomoe＊＠１７６＿０２４This pendant is￥my good-luck charm.＝＠１７６＿０２５My grandmother worried I was too￥shy and gave it to me, saying,￥"This will make you strong."＝＠１７６＿０２６It's plain, almost￥like a toy, but...＝＠１７６＿０２７Even so, it really helps me￥a lot, you know.
＊Tomoe＊＠１７６＿０２８Let's see...＝＠１７６＿０２９When I'm anxious, touching it￥calms me down, strangely enough.＝＠１７６＿０３０It makes me feel like maybe I￥can manage, even when things￥are hard...
＊Tomoe＊＠１７６＿０３１I can't really explain it...＝＠１７６＿０３２But even when I'm scared,￥touching it gives me the courage￥to try.
＊Tomoe＊...＝＠２０８＿００１Until now, as long as I had￥this pendant, I could somehow￥cope...＝＠２０８＿００２But now...
＊Tomoe＊＠２０８＿００３I wonder how everyone else￥handles it...＝＠２０８＿００４We're part of such a big￥project, after all...＝＠２０８＿００５I'm sure they're all under huge￥pressure too, and working hard.
＊Tomoe＊＠２０８＿００６Yes... I suppose so.＝＠２０８＿００７But I don't have the strength￥to fight that fight.＝＠２０８＿００８I know that myself.￥That's why I get so anxious...
＊Tomoe＊...＝＠２０８＿００９I used to think so too. If I￥worked hard, it'd all work out.＝＠２０８＿０１０I really believed that, but...
＊Tomoe＊...＝＠２０８＿０１１In the end... this is something￥I'll have to solve on my own,￥isn't it?
＊Tomoe＊＠２０８＿０１２I'm sorry for making you listen￥to my silly problems.＝＠２０８＿０１３But talking to you... made me￥feel a little better.
＊Tomoe＊＠２０８＿０１４And also...＝＠２０８＿０１５I've never... told anyone about￥this pendant before.＝＠２０８＿０１６It felt childish, and I was￥embarrassed...
＊Tomoe＊＠２０８＿０１７But you didn't laugh... you￥listened seriously...＝＠２０８＿０１８Thank you.
